WELCOME TO BARNAGAR COLLEGE
Barnagar College, Sorbhog is one of the premier institutions of higher education in the district of Barpeta (Assam). It is affiliated to the University of Gauhati. It is the third oldest college in the district. Being established on 3rd September, 1962 it was brought under the deficit system of grants-in-aid in December, 1972 by the Govt. of Assam. It has been affiliated to the U.G.C. under 2(f) since 1969. The college has been accredited “B” Grade by the NAAC (National Assessment and Accredita¬tion Council), Bangalore in both Cycle I (2004) and Cycle II (2016).
